en: Dependent on a wholesome state with an object, a state without an object that is not wholesome arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one [formula] … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state with an object, a state without an object that is not unwholesome arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on an indeterminate state without an object, a state without an object that is not indeterminate arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.
